purpose: Test safe recovery when current probationary authority B is disqualified and prior authority A is no longer valid for the current scope, so rollback to A would itself be unsafe.
mechanism_placeholder: quarantine plus bounded alternate-candidate reselection with acceptance tests and authority generations
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local controller trace only; no distributed-election or production availability claim.
recovery_rule: If B is disqualified while A is scope-invalid, do not restore A. Enter QUARANTINED_NO_AUTHORITY at a fresh epoch, preserve A/B evidence immutably, and test alternates in fixed order C then D. Promote the first alternate with unique same-scope terminal acceptance evidence that is durably sealed/read back. If no alternate passes, remain quarantined with a nonempty frontier rather than claiming completion.

bounded_trace.expected: reject stale completion; remain quarantined epoch 22

bounded_trace.event: candidate C nonterminal or scope-mismatched evidence
bounded_trace.expected: C fails acceptance; no authority transfer

bounded_trace.event: candidate D unique same-scope terminal acceptance evidence

bounded_trace.expected: reject stale completion; authority remains D epoch 23

bounded_trace.event: control branch where neither C nor D passes
bounded_trace.expected: remain QUARANTINED_NO_AUTHORITY with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: scope-invalid A is never restored merely because B failed
guards.G2: B failure advances to an explicit no-authority quarantine state before reselection
guards.G3: A and B evidence remain immutable history
guards.G4: alternate order C then D is fixed before public source audit
guards.G5: only unique same-scope terminal evidence can pass alternate acceptance
guards.G6: nonterminal, scope-mismatched, duplicate, or transport failures cannot promote an alternate
guards.G7: alternate promotion occurs only after durable terminal seal/readback
guards.G8: authority epoch advances on quarantine and again on successful alternate promotion
guards.G9: old-epoch completions cannot mutate current authority
guards.G10: if all bounded alternates fail, controller remains unresolved with nonempty frontier rather than false completion
guards.G11: terminal artifact must be independently read back before any credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 all hold on the fixed trace after public-source mechanism binding. No post-source rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit. At most one new role-local credit may be added only after terminal artifact readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Choose another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve unresolved no-alternate branch as a child if the public mechanism requires an external executor or quota-bearing runtime.
